name: fsu-fut-extension
description: Unpacked Chrome extension wrapper for the FSU EAFC FUT Web userscript.

scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:all && npm run test:browser
scripts.package:all: npm run build && npm run package && npm run package:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run check:version && npm run lint && npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- src/userscript.js && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run test:browser && npm run check:ea-release -- --require && npm run package && npm run package:smoke
